name: radio-accordion
title: Radio accordion
description: Payment or delivery methods as radio rows where the chosen one opens its own panel beneath and the others stay shut.
docs: options are { value, label, description?, trailing?, icon?, content?, disabled? }; control the group with value and onValueChange or start it with defaultValue. The group is a radio group, so arrow keys choose and move the focus and Tab leaves it; name it with label (or aria-labelledby). The row is one big target: the label stretches over it and the radio keeps the focus ring. The panel of the chosen row is a region labelled by that row and opens beneath it, the others stay shut, and the focus never moves into a panel by itself. trailing is text at the end of the row ('Free', 'Instant', '4.95'), read out after the description. A closed panel is not in the page: its fields cannot be reached with Tab and a required field in it never blocks a form, so keep what is typed in state of your own, as the demo does. The height animates and is instant under reduced motion.
